title: Localized exact transformations on single complexes
statement: For exact additive functors F,G between abelian categories with derived categories, a natural transformation alpha, an integer n and object X, the localized cochain natural transformation at single_n(X), followed by the G exact/single comparison, equals the F exact/single comparison followed by single_n(alpha_X).

proof.text: Evaluate liftNatTrans at the cochain single, unfold the canonical exact/single comparisons and cancel mapDerivedCategoryFactors for G. Combine Q maps. In the support degree the singleMapHomologicalComplex comparisons are the canonical singleObjXSelf maps, which cancel by naturality; in every other degree the target is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem exactSingle_transformation
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Abelian A] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B]
    (F G : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (α : F ⟶ G) (n : ℤ) (X : A) :
    (Localization.liftNatTrans _root_.DerivedCategory.Q
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso A (.up ℤ)) _ _
      F.mapDerivedCategory G.mapDerivedCategory
      (Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex α (.up ℤ))
        _root_.DerivedCategory.Q)).app
        ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A n).obj X) ≫
      (G.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor n).hom.app X =
    (F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor n).hom.app X ≫
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B n).map (α.app X)
